Type: chair
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Classic Spindle-Back Armless Wood Dining Chair, 19"W, Set of 2, Black
Colors: Black
This set of 2 traditional dining chairs features an updated take on the classic spindle-backed style, lending an air of homespun charm to any setting. The beautiful glossy black finish adds the final touch of sophistication. 19.7"D x 19"W x 31"H Set of 2 chairs Solid rubberwood with a black finish and comfortable back These dining chairs are crafted in a simple, modern design that can blend with traditional and modern styles. Simple assembly in less than 15 minutes Use a dampened, soft and clean cloth with water only. Wipe in the direction of the grain. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
